reference_version.text:
We chose Postgres for billing. Two reasons.

First, billing reports join invoices, customers and plans, and joins are painful in DynamoDB. Second, an invoice and its ledger entries must change together, so we need transactions.

The cost is that we scale writes ourselves, which is fine at our volume for the next two years.
